text.aria-label: Title text 'D5: verified load-shift of -1.5 MW for 15 days, starting 2025-12-29 Black solid: observed power. Black dashed: the NRA (observed minus the fitted load-shift). Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the load-shift. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: origin days with the gate on or held.'
text.tspan: D5: verified load-shift of -1.5 MW for 15 days, starting 2025-12-29
Black solid: observed power. Black dashed: the NRA (observed minus the fitted load-shift). Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band.
Grey shade: the load-shift. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: origin days with the gate on or held.
